<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 233.9632, which likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral mass of approximately 232.956 Da. The isotopic pattern (significant M+2 peak) indicates the presence of one chlorine atom. A plausible formula that matches this mass and includes one chlorine is C13H9ClO2.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H9ClO2</final_answer>
